name: Haiti

tax.name: Tax Authority (Direction Générale des Impôts, DGI)

support.name: Office of Work Injury and Health Insurance (OFATMA)

legalStatuses.label: Sole trader (registered business)
legalStatuses.plain: You run the business as an individual under your own name or a business name. You and the business are the same person for tax. Usually the simplest way to start.
legalStatuses.feeNote: You pay a yearly patente: a fixed fee of G 5,000, G 2,500 or G 1,250 depending on the town, plus 0.4% of your sales minus your payroll.

legalStatuses.label: Limited company
legalStatuses.plain: The company is its own legal person, separate from you. It costs more to set up and has more paperwork, but it can limit your personal risk.
legalStatuses.feeNote: A company is incorporated through a notary and costs more to set up than a sole trader business.

launchSteps.label: Choose your business name and check that it is free
launchSteps.plain: Search the name at the Commercial Registry first.

launchSteps.label: Register with the Commercial Registry
launchSteps.plain: Documents are filed in French or Creole. A company is incorporated through a notary.

launchSteps.label: Get your tax number (NIF) from the DGI
launchSteps.plain: You also register for the turnover tax (TCA) if you sell goods or services.

launchSteps.label: Pay your patente and get your professional card
launchSteps.plain: The patente is a yearly local tax with a fixed part and a part based on sales.

launchSteps.label: Open a separate bank account for the business
launchSteps.plain: Keeping business money apart from household money makes your numbers clearer and your taxes easier to pay.

launchSteps.label: Register with the ONA and OFATMA and prepare monthly payments
launchSteps.plain: With employees you pay the payroll tax (2%) by the 15th of each month, plus social security contributions to the ONA.

incomeTax.label: Income tax
incomeTax.allowanceNote: no tax on the first G 60,000 a year

vat.label: Turnover tax (TCA)
vat.registerNote: Register with the DGI when you start selling goods or services. Basic food and medicines are exempt.
vat.filingNote: You file your TCA return every month.

calendar.monthlyText: File and pay your TCA return for the previous month.
calendar.annualTextPersonal: File your final income tax return for the previous year.
calendar.payrollText: Every month, from the 1st to the 15th: pay the payroll tax (2%) and the ONA contributions for the previous month.
calendar.vatText: File your TCA return every month.

notes: Haiti has a 10% turnover tax (TCA). Sole traders pay income tax at 10% to 30% above G 60,000, and companies pay 30%.
The patente is a yearly local tax: a fixed fee (G 1,250 to G 5,000 depending on the town) plus 0.4% of sales minus payroll. Your estimate includes the 0.4% part on sales.
toVerify: Fixed part of the patente for your town
